plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Web Development, Computer Information Technology, AAS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/computer-information-technology-web-development-aas/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid, hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 3 = 'See Approved General Education List for the AAS Degree', 4 = 'See program recommendations or requirements' — those slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions; see advisor. The schedule grid also includes unnamed slots with no footnotes (3rd semester: one 3-unit; 4th semester: one 5-unit); they are modeled as choice slots with an honest 'not defined on this page; see advisor' note. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
